In the next screen:

 1. Tap "Downloaded apps" or "Installed apps"
 2. Select "Reels Blocker Service"
 3. Toggle it ON
 4. Tap OK on the confirmation dialog

 Then return to this app.

On MIUI / HyperOS:

 1. Open Security app
 2. Tap "App lock" → "Manage apps"
 OR go to Settings → Apps → Manage apps → Reels Blocker
 3. Tap "Autostart" and enable it
 4. Also enable "Battery saver" → "No restrictions" for this app

 Then return here and tap Start on the service row.

On EMUI / HarmonyOS:

 1. Open Settings → Apps → Apps
 2. Find "Reels Blocker" and tap it
 3. Tap "Battery" → select "Run in background"
 4. Go back, tap "Startup" and enable "Auto-launch"

 Then return here and tap Start on the service row.

On ColorOS / OxygenOS / realme UI:

 1. Open Settings → Battery → Battery optimization
 2. Tap the three-dot menu → "All apps"
 3. Find "Reels Blocker" → select "Don't optimize"
 4. Also go to Settings → Apps → Reels Blocker → Battery → Allow background activity

 Then return here and tap Start on the service row.

On Vivo / iQOO:

 1. Open iManager (or Settings → Battery)
 2. Tap "Background app management" or "High-power apps"
 3. Enable "Reels Blocker" in the list
 4. Also go to Settings → Apps → Reels Blocker → Permissions → Autostart

 Then return here and tap Start on the service row.

On Samsung One UI:

 1. Open Settings → Apps → Reels Blocker
 2. Tap "Battery" → select "Unrestricted"
 3. Go back to Apps list → tap three-dot menu → "Special access" → "Optimize battery usage"
 4. Switch from "Apps" to "All apps", find Reels Blocker and turn it OFF

 Then return here and tap Start on the service row.

To keep the blocker running reliably:

 1. Go to Settings → Apps → Reels Blocker → Battery
 2. Select "Unrestricted" or "Don't optimize"
 3. If your phone has an autostart setting, enable it for Reels Blocker

 Then return here and tap Start on the service row.
No data is collected or shared.\nAll processing happens on-device.
